artist.name: J.Kail
artist.bio: J.Kail (Jatin Verma) is a rising Punjabi singer, lyricist, composer and music producer based in Ludhiana, Punjab. Running his own independent setup, J.Kail Production, he releases a steady stream of urban Desi, hip-hop and emotive Punjabi tracks. He has gained traction through collaborative EPs, albums and singles with indie artists like Emo Devil, Gagan Bhatoye, Yoddha, Zehn, Flameboy and Muzikidd.

services.title: Live Show Bookings
services.description: High-octane Punjabi & Urban Desi live performances for weddings, college fests, club shows, corporate gigs, and private VIP events.

services.title: Music Production
services.description: Commercial-grade Punjabi, Hip-Hop, Drill, and Urban Desi music production tailored to industry streaming standards.

services.title: Mixing & Mastering
services.description: Pristine audio fidelity, punchy bass, balanced vocal depth, and loudness optimization ready for Spotify & Apple Music.

services.title: Custom Song Creation
services.description: Bespoke singing, lyrical compositions, melodies, and full soundtrack arrangements crafted for artists, labels, and personal milestones.
